label: Agent: Place Call
description: Place an outbound phone call with a configured ElevenLabs voice agent. The agent holds the conversation on its own; wire the conversation id into Agent: Get Conversation for the transcript.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account (agents and phone numbers live in it; the shared credential cannot serve this).

inputs.name: agent
inputs.label: Agent
inputs.placeholder: Pick an agent, or paste its id

inputs.name: phoneNumber
inputs.label: From number
inputs.placeholder: Pick an imported number, or paste its id
inputs.description: The agent's imported phone number (Agents > Phone Numbers).

inputs.name: toNumber
inputs.label: To number
inputs.description: The number to call, E.164 format.

inputs.name: dynamicVariables
inputs.description: Values for the agent prompt's {{variables}}, e.g. { "customer_name": "Ada" }.

outputs.name: conversationId
outputs.description: The conversation's id: what Get Conversation takes.
